headline: Russian strike kills woman at Kyiv's National Academy of Sciences amid nationwide bombardment

supports: A woman was killed in a Russian strike on Kyiv's National Academy of Sciences in the Shevchenkivskyi district on Monday, September 28, 2026.
Russia's round-the-clock bombardment of targets across Ukraine on September 28 killed at least seven people nationwide and wounded more than 50 others, officials said.
A separate drone strike hit an office center in central Dnipro on September 28, killing three people and wounding at least 12.

caption:
🇺🇸 A Russian strike killed a woman at Kyiv's National Academy of Sciences on Sept. 28 as part of a nationwide bombardment that also struck an office center in Dnipro, killing more people there. CBS News reported at least seven dead and over 50 wounded across Ukraine from the day's attacks, while The Irish Times separately confirmed the Academy of Sciences death and the Dnipro strike.

🇪🇸 Un ataque ruso mató a una mujer en la Academia Nacional de Ciencias de Kiev el 28 de septiembre, parte de un bombardeo a escala nacional que también golpeó un centro de oficinas en Dnipró, causando más muertes allí. CBS News reportó al menos siete muertos y más de 50 heridos en Ucrania por los ataques del día, mientras que The Irish Times confirmó de forma independiente la muerte en la Academia de Ciencias y el ataque en Dnipró.

Sources: CBS News / The Irish Times — Sept. 28, 2026.
